## Summary

**Final follow-up to `opencharly/.github#128` + `#131`** (the merged cross-surface reconciliation gate). The `marketplace projection` rows for four subjects pointed at the generated `internals/skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md` — but those canonical phrases live in its generated **reference** file, `internals/skills/git-workflow/references/multi-repo-coordination.md` (the `git-workflow` skill is a multi-file split; the sign-off/takeover/successor prose is in the reference). **Fix:** point each of the four subjects' `marketplace projection` rows at `marketplace/internals/skills/git-workflow/references/multi-repo-coordination.md` (the file that actually carries the phrase). **The gate now passes FULLY against every reconciled surface** — measured below.
